The '''Hull's Star system''' was a part of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> region of [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]], which contained no [[Planet/Legends|planets]], was connected by the [[Tertiary Etti Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Farana system/Legends|Farana]] and [[Mytus system/Legends|Mytus systems]], and its only significance was due to it being a jumping-off point for the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]], which was located on a [[Mytus VII/Legends|planetoid]] within the Mytus system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hull's Star system was first described in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the system in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
